summary: Clover Health Investments, Corp. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing an update from CMS regarding Medicare Advantage Star Ratings. CMS recalculated Clover's PPO contract (H5141) to 4.5 Stars and its HMO contract (H8010) to 4.5 Stars for payment year 2027, following a court judgment. This is a regulatory/non-financial event, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board actions, or capital structure changes. The filing is a standard current report of a material operational update.
